title: merge-apply input — the approved, head-SHA-pinned per-PR action list

repo.description: Short repo name as configured in config/repos.yaml — not the GitHub owner/name slug

github.description: GitHub owner/name slug the merge commands run against — anchored so it substitutes safely into the closed argv templates

plan.description: Approved per-PR actions from the merge-scan proposal, applied in order

pr.description: GitHub pull request number the action applies to

headSha.description: PR head commit the scan reviewed — merge_pr probes the live head and refuses if it moved

ticket.description: Linear ticket the PR fixes (the item key in the applied record)

action.description: Closed-registry action to apply — anything else refuses the whole plan before executing any item

reason.description: One-line justification kept for the audit trail; notify_escalate substitutes it into the push and refuses without it
